content.text: Note: SSRIs + venlafaxine relative potency = mg ≈ fluoxetine 40 mg/day (Hayasaka 2015; *citalopram = clin SSRI eq)    -    other SNRIs have ⍉ RCT fluoxetine-eq -> shown by SERT:NET selectivity (5HT-pref -> NE-pref):    -    venlafaxine ~30:1 (most serotonergic) > desvenlafaxine > duloxetine ~10:1 > milnacipran ~2:1 NE > levomilnacipran (most NE-selective; 17× venlafaxine, 27× duloxetine @ NET)

content.text: -    Admin: Taper: gradual    -    monitor like SSRI
-    MOA: major active metabolite of venlafaxine (O-desmethylvenlafaxine, ODV)    -    ⍉ QT prolongation (thorough QTc study)
-    Duration: t½: 5 h (ODV 11 h)    -    venlafaxine + active metabolite ODV = SNRI (weak DA)    -    ↓dose -> ↑5HT only    -    mod-high dose -> ↑5HT & NE
-    SE: also HA, insomnia, drowsiness, dizziness, diaphoresis, nausea, xerostomia, anorexia, nervousness, ↓libido, pharyngitis
Duloxetine (Cymbalta)- exception ends like SSRIs- careful! (best anxiety)
-    SE: GI (diarrhea, nausea)    -    irritability    -    liver toxicity    -    anticholinergic effects
-    SE: also HA, drowsiness, fatigue, xerostomia, abd pain, wt loss, weakness
-    CI: ↑DI    -    ⍉ use if hepatic impair    -    ⍉ chronic liver dz/cirrhosis    -    ⍉ severe renal (GFR <30)
-    Caution: dose-related ↑HR/BP    -    renal dosing    -    ⍉ w MAOI

content.text: -    MOA: weak block of DAT/NET -> ↑[NE/DA synaptic] (⍉ 5HT)    -    aminoketone (unrelated to TCA/SSRI)
-    SE: insomnia    -    anorexia    -    sz (↓ sz threshold)    -    HA    -    GI    -    xerostomia
-    CI: sz dx    -    eating dx (bulimia/anorexia — ↑sz risk)    -    abrupt EToH/benzo/AED w.draw    -    MAOI (w.in 14D)
-    Note: activating (⍉ sexual dysfun, ⍉ wt gain)    -    t½ ~21 h
-    MOA: block presynaptic α2 (autoreceptor) -> ⍉ autoinhibition -> ↑NE/5HT release    -    block 5HT2/5HT3 -> ↓anxiety/nausea    -    block H1 -> sedation
-    SE: sedation    -    wt gain    -    ↑appetite    -    constipation    -    hypercholest     -    tremor (when adj)
-    MOA: SARI — weak 5HT reuptake-i (-> ↑5HT) + 5HT2A antagonist (-> sedation, ↓anxiety)
-    Clin Use: MDD    -    less sexual dysfun than SSRIs
-    Caution: take w food (fasted AUC ↓~50%)    -    diarrhea, nausea    -    ⍉ w MAOI    -    t½ ~25 h

: weak inhibitor of both SERT & NET, but = a potent antagonist of the postsynaptic 5HT2A-r, as are its metabolites
: approved for maintenance tx of depression & hsp depressed pts

: inhibits 5HT reuptake, it = an agonist @ 5HT1A receptors, & a partial agonist @ 5HT1B; also acts as an antagonist @ multi 5HT-r subtypes (3, 1D, 7)
: 2wk washout period w/ MAOIs to ⍉serotonin syndrome & hypertensive crisis
: similar to SSRIs – may cause less sexual dysfun

: Clin Use in oncology & skilled nursing facilities to help w/ sleep & to increase appetite (wt gain in frail, elderly pts)
